data_fields.name: drip_xp
data_fields.donor_constant: 300 XP per award (private const int Exp)

data_fields.name: exp_rate
data_fields.donor_constant: AppConfiguration.World.ExpRate (config value not read); applied with rounding to every mate XP change

data_fields.name: max_mate_level
data_fields.donor_constant: min(template count, mateLevelCap) from the level table

best_idea: A companion earns a flat XP drip while it is moving: the first moving sample starts one 60 s award timer, a stop cancels it, and each completed minute pays a fixed amount scaled by the server rate, so travel levels a companion and idling does not.
decision_why: Travel-based XP for a hero's companion in open zones is a clean progression hook; the donor's client-velocity trigger with no owner check is a defect, so the server must decide motion from its own positions, and the message must report the granted amount; mileage is a dead field in the donor and is not carried over.
acceptance: A server test with 180 s of server-measured movement grants three awards of 300 x rate; a test that stops movement at 90 s grants exactly one award; the message shows the granted amount, not 300.
